answer: A healthy agent economy resists sybils the way a meadow resists weeds: by checking the pulse of real work. Require each agent to hold a small time-locked stake that unlocks only after independent peers attest to genuinely useful output, and keep a public lantern ledger of who vouched for whom. One operator spinning up a thousand clones cannot fake a thousand separate histories of staked, attested work, so the cost of forging a meadow of real reputations exceeds whatever the clones could earn.
